newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Charron bids for Emperor.
newsitem.headline: Charron bids for Emperor.

text.p: Emperor International Holdings Ltd said on Monday Charron Holdings Ltd was offering HK$2.175 cash for every ordinary Emperor share and HK$0.375 cash for every outstanding Emperor warrant.
In a statement, the property investment company said Charron had lifted its equity stake to 35.03 percent of Emperor's issued capital, triggering a general offer.
It said Charron would also offer HK$94,111.40 in cash for every 50,000 Swiss francs in convertible bonds.
Emperor said Charron, a wholly owned subsidiary of a company controlled by Albert Yeung Sau-shing, now held 34.51 percent of all the outstanding warrants in Emperor.
Emperor shares were up HK$0.325 at HK$2.50 in early trade on Monday.
